algorithm: latent skill model (VAE over demonstrations) for skill-planned trajectory initialization, refined by gradient-based trajectory optimization through a differentiable MPM simulator, with refined rollouts fed back as new demonstrations
sim: PlasticineLab (MLS-MPM, CUDA), built on Hu et al. 2018's Moving Least Squares Material Point Method
headline_metric: normalized improvement in Earth Mover's Distance (EMD) to goal shape, d(t) = (d0 - dt)/d0, thresholded at a minimum of 0 (EMD approximated via Sinkhorn Divergence)
human_data: 10 human teleoperated demonstrations per task variant (own collected, via Leap Motion optical hand-tracking retargeted through IK to the simulated Shadow hand; ~60,000 environment steps / ~2 hours of human interaction total, Sec. 3.1)
note_gaps: dt, substeps, ground_friction, mu, E (Young's modulus), nu (Poisson's ratio), and yield_stress are confirmed as MPMSimulator constructor parameters in code/md but no numeric defaults are given in either parsed source. The 15-20 FPS figure (App. B) is a full teleoperation pipeline (sim+render+human-in-the-loop) number on a laptop RTX 3070, not a batched-simulation throughput figure. No explicit contact-force law, solver-iteration count, or penetration metric is exposed anywhere in the parsed text; contact is entirely implicit in the MPM grid transfer.
